name: PETRONAS PFLNG Satu (PFLNG 1), Kanowit then Kebabangan, offshore Malaysia
location: Kanowit gas field, offshore Sarawak (2016-2019); Kebabangan (KBB) field, offshore Sabah (since 2019)
description: world's first operational floating LNG vessel: 360 m long, 1.2 Mtpa; first gas November 2016 at Kanowit, 180 km offshore Bintulu; redeployed to the Kebabangan (KBB) field, offshore Sabah, in 2019; 50th cargo delivered by October 2021; acid gas removal designed by PETRONAS and UOP (Amine Guard FS) for floating service

capacities.basis: stated in the naming release and the UOP acid-gas-removal announcement
